observations: Front view of a red Mack truck.
MACK branding is clearly visible on the grille in photo 0.
Black heavy-duty bumper with two tow hooks.
Headlight lenses appear aged or cloudy.
Aftermarket LED light bars are mounted on the lower grille.
The trailer (lowbed) mentioned in the text is not visible in the photo.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'AWSOME' are overlaid on the image.

claims.evidence: The trailer is not shown in the photo; only the tractor unit is visible.
Requires a video clip of the engine starting and running.
The chassis rails are not visible in this front-facing shot.
The tyres are not visible in the provided photo.

risks.proof: Video of the engine running with a view of the dashboard gauges.
Photos of the lowbed trailer from multiple angles.

risks.risk: Structural chassis damage or excessive corrosion
risks.proof: Clear photos of the frame rails and suspension components.
Close-up photos of all tyre treads and sidewall date codes.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring immediate full tyre replacement

proof_requests: Photos of the lowbed trailer mentioned.
Video of the engine running and the truck moving.
Photos of the chassis rails and rear suspension.
Photos of the interior, dashboard, and odometer.
Photos of all tyres showing tread depth.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (VIN plate).
response.reason: A single front-view photo is insufficient to value a heavy-duty truck and trailer. Critical components like the trailer, engine, chassis, and tyres are completely hidden.
